The '''City Government Complex''' was an area located within the central [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], the second largest settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The complex was nested in the [[Government Education Center]].
